players.product: utility T&D grid infrastructure (transmission/substation connectors and hardware up to 765 kV, System Control control houses) and data-center electrical components (Burndy connectors, PCX power skids, 800 V pin & sleeve devices)

quarterly_data.signal: Hubbell's 10-K reports a backlog of orders believed to be firm of $2,159 million at December 31, 2025, compared with $1,898 million at December 31, 2024. Substantially all of the December 31, 2025 backlog in the Electrical Solutions segment is expected to ship in 2026; in Utility Solutions substantially all backlog is expected to ship during 2026, along with approximately $20 million of backlog of multi-year contracts, primarily long-term contracts to deliver and install meters and grid monitoring sensor technology.
quarterly_data.figure: backlog $2,159 million at December 31, 2025 (vs $1,898 million at December 31, 2024); approximately $20 million of multi-year Utility Solutions contract backlog
